in_hebrew.name: חילתן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From Hebrew חיל (chayil) meaning 'strength' and אל (el) meaning 'God'. Thus, Hiltan means 'God is my strength'.

in_greek.name: ἵλταν
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hiltan does not have a direct Greek equivalent.

in_latin.name: Hiltanus
in_latin.long_meaning: From Latin 'Hiltanus'. The name is derived from 'Hiltan', which means 'God is my strength' in Hebrew. The Latin form 'Hiltanus' translates to 'God's man'.
